title.en: Income Tax (Argosy Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Argosy Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2023 and is deemed to have come into operation on 30 September 2019.

2.—(1) The interest payable by Argosy Pte. Ltd. —
(a)to the lenders mentioned in the first column of the following table;
(b)in respect of the respective loan amounts mentioned in the second column of the table, being amounts that are or are to be used for the purpose of financing the purchase and installation of an exhaust gas cleaning system or a scrubber system of the respective vessels mentioned in the third column of the table;
(c)under the respective agreements mentioned in the fourth column of the table; and
(d)that is due and payable during the respective periods mentioned in the fifth column of the table,
is exempt from tax:
